name: Zabbix Docker
what_it_is: Official Docker containerization of Zabbix, an enterprise-class monitoring platform. The repository provides Dockerfiles and Compose files to deploy the full Zabbix monitoring stack including server, web UI, agents, proxies, and SNMP trap receiver.
configuration: OS base image selection (Alpine, CentOS, Oracle Linux, Ubuntu)
Compose profiles for partial or full stack deployment (minimal, full, all)
Image version via ZBX_IMAGE_TAG environment variable
IPv6 network support toggle via environment variables
MySQL credentials supplied via secrets files in ENV_VARS_DIRECTORY
modes: Minimal deployment (default Compose profile — server + DB only)
Full deployment (all Zabbix components enabled via 'full' profile)
All components deployment (includes additional tools via 'all' profile)
constraints: Versions 7.0+ are licensed under AGPLv3; commercial use requires purchasing technical support from Zabbix LLC
MySQL and PostgreSQL are external dependencies — the compose stack does not bundle a production-ready DB by default without the databases compose file
Docker Compose profiles must be explicitly selected to activate non-default services; minimal profile starts very few services
Agent2 and proxy images are separate from the server image and must be configured independently
notable_absences: No built-in PostgreSQL service in the default compose.yaml (MySQL-centric by default)
No pre-configured alerting rules or dashboards — must be configured via the web UI after deployment
No built-in network topology discovery — discovery must be configured manually
No native Prometheus/OpenMetrics scraping endpoint on the server itself
No built-in TLS termination — external reverse proxy or manual cert configuration required
